content: Cefuroxime is a semisynthetic, broad-spectrum cephalosporin antibiotic designed for parenteral administration. Each gram of cefuroxime activity contains 4.4 mEq of sodium. The formulation includes 750 mg or 1.5 g of cefuroxime as cefuroxime sodium. The solutions of ZINACEF vary in color from light yellow to amber, depending on the concentration and the diluent used. For the 750-mg dose, 4 g of Dextrose Hydrous, USP, has been added to adjust the osmolality. The pH of the solution has been adjusted using hydrochloric acid and, if necessary, sodium hydroxide. Premixed ZINACEF solutions also range in color from light yellow to amber. These solutions are intended for intravenous (IV) use after being thawed to room temperature. The frozen solution is packaged in a specially designed multilayer plastic container, known as PL 2040. The solutions come into contact with the polyethylene layer of this container, and trace amounts of certain chemical components from the plastic may leach into the solution over the product's shelf life. The suitability of the plastic container has been confirmed through animal testing in accordance with USP biological tests for plastic containers, as well as through tissue culture toxicity studies.
